Subject: Post-call: FintechCo private/VPC pricing — token volumes & licensing follow-up

Hi Jamie — thanks again for the call today. Great to meet you and Alex. Quick recap and a few clarifying questions so we can put together a tailored private/VPC quote: 

Recap: 
- Use case: customer-facing risk detection + in-product assistant for bankers.
- Deployment preference: Private (VPC) inside FintechCo with customer-managed network; likely on AWS in us-east-1.
- Priority: strict data isolation + auditability (SOC 2 requirements).

Clarifying asks (so our pricing model lines up):
1) Expected token volumes: monthly active users, avg tokens per interaction, monthly total tokens. If you have a peak TPS or peak concurrent chat sessions that helps sizing.
2) Budget posture: target $/1M tokens or target annual committed spend (so we can map license vs usage).
3) Environments: how many environments would you need (prod/staging/dev/DR)?
4) Support tier: Standard vs Premium (Premium includes 24/7 and a TAM). Which do you prefer?

Attached is our high-level pricing deck for Private/VPC to orient the discussion. If you can reply with the numbers above, I’ll put together: (a) a sample licensed pricing + support quote and (b) an example token-unit economics table showing how $/1M tokens maps back to estimated monthly spend for your volumes.

Next steps: please loop in procurement if you want an official quote/PO path.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Ben — thanks for the recap and the deck. Couple quick answers from our side: 

- Expected volumes (initial, month 1): ~10k MAU, ~2 interactions per MAU/day, avg ~400 tokens per interaction. That maps to ~24M tokens/month. We expect growth to ~100M tokens/month over 6–12 months if adoption is strong.
- Peak concurrency: expect <50 concurrent sessions during business hours; burst tolerance needed for end-of-day batch processes.
- Budget: our procurement folks have given a target range for this POC/first year of $120k–$200k ARR for infra + license. For unit economics, the internal target is roughly $150–$250 per 1M tokens (this will vary depending on license/support commitments).
- Environments: we will want prod + staging + dev (3). Might also ask about a DR standby later.
- Support: leaning toward Premium (24/7) given production SLAs.

Looping procurement (procurement@fintechco.com) to coordinate next steps. Can you provide: sample quote for Private/VPC with (a) committed annual license + support, (b) committed throughput pricing per 1M tokens, and (c) any setup/one-time fees? Also attach standard license terms so our legal can start a review.

Thanks,
Jamie Li
Head of Platform Integrations, FintechCo

Thanks Jamie — good data, that helps a lot. Per your ask, attached are two items: (1) draft SOW (high level) and (2) our license terms doc. High-level pricing notes below — I’ll follow up with a more formal quote to procurement.

High-level commercial approaches for Private/VPC:
A) Annual license + support (common for Private):
   - Example: $120k annual license for the runtime + control plane for a 3-environment deployment (prod/staging/dev) sized to ~100M tokens/month equivalent throughput.
   - Support Tiers: Standard (business hours email) included; Premium + TAM is an add-on (example +$20k/year).
   - Setup/one-time: deployment & onboarding + initial sizing workshop (one-time $15k–$25k).

B) Committed throughput / unit economics (if you want a $/1M tokens mapping):
   - For private deployments we typically map committed throughput to an effective $/1M tokens for internal benchmarking. Example consumption table:
     • Small commit (24M tokens/mo): effective $/1M = $240
     • Mid commit (100M tokens/mo): effective $/1M = $150
     • Large commit (500M+ tokens/mo): effective $/1M = $85

   These numbers fold in license + support + amortized infra ops for the private deployment.

C) Hybrid: a smaller license + overage per token (used when customers want lower baseline commit).

Given your stated initial target (~24M tokens/mo) and budget range ($120k–$200k), an example first-year structure that aligns with your ask could be:
  - Annual license (Private/VPC) sized for growth to 100M tokens/month: $120k
  - Premium support (24/7 + TAM): $20k
  - Setup/onboarding: $20k (one-time)
  = Total first-year committed: $160k (fits your range).

If you prefer a strict $/1M token comparison for the initial phase, the effective $/1M on a 24M commit is ~ $240 (see table). If you move to a 100M commit, the effective $/1M comes down to ~$150.

Adding a few technical notes to help procurement/infra planning: 

- Environment count: we typically price per-deployment (prod/staging/dev) for private installs because each env requires its own reserved GPU pools and network setup; however, we can offer a consolidated license model with an environment multiplier discount (common to do 3 envs at ~1.6x the single-prod license instead of 3x).
- Token accounting: KV/prefix caching and batching lower effective token consumption for repeated prompts. For your in-product assistant, effective tokens per interaction may drop after warm caches. We'll include conservative and warmed scenarios in the quote.
- Sizing: for 100M tokens/month with <100 concurrent sessions, recommended starting footprint is 4x A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale/burst policies (we model throughput and latency tradeoffs in the SOW).
- Compliance: SOC 2 report and audit logs are provided as part of the Private Enterprise package (I’ve attached the SOC2 stub).

Happy to do a quick technical call with your infra/procurement teams if that helps accelerate the PO.

-Rishi
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
